Select approved drugs (max_phase = 4) with mechanism of action action_type 'POSITIVE ALLOSTERIC MODULATOR'. Join molecule_dictionary to drug_mechanism on molregno, and to target_dictionary on tid. Join compound_structures on molregno as an INNER JOIN to require canonical SMILES. Return chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, max_phase, mechanism_of_action, action_type, target_chembl_id (target_dictionary.chembl_id), and target_name (target_dictionary.pref_name). Sort by chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, max_phase, mechanism_of_action, action_type, target_chembl_id, target_name.
